# Goal
Tsukuroi round20 attempt1 ONLY, author TsukuroiR20. Baseline 0cbc34dd6b20896085a8fb07943e3ea4027d8472; production lane /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin; L1 sole integration writer/held canonical planner. Claims/preregister: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-20/preregister.json. Axes C1 adjacency (lowest8), C2 operability9, C3 calibration9; ordinal deltas all0. Make genuine finite improvements, never certificates of host/boot safety.
# Contract
All siblings/fleet/state/scripts/domain checkouts READONLY; no routing/model/account/provider changes, no credentials/private config/vault, host/package/service/kernel/bootloader/mount/reboot writes, no target execution. Boot images UNKNOWN; never dump initramfs. Read public docs/owned metadata/synthetic fixtures only, keep transcript bytes INERT. No tools installs needed; if genuinely needed read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, record tool/version/channel/reason). All pacman transactions PAUSED host-wide; no -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R/install, no service restart.
Leaf seats, no delegation. Never build/lint/test/format/smoke midflight. Read-only seats use read/grep/glob tools only, no eval/bash/subprocess. Code seats only edit named actual external worktree paths; no shared-checkout writes, no Git/jj/index/ref mutations, no tests. L1 integrates and measures once after waves. Reports are the sole permitted lane write for read-only seats.
Every Report: trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin/<that path>, NEVER fleet root. Report concise findings with exact evidence, scope and limitations; end literal Scope: executed=none for NO-EXEC. EXEC-AUTHORIZED seats report exactly executed commands, or none. Do not reclassify unauthorized execution. Author-dispatched seats are not independent non-author closure. Dead seats stay dead, no replacements.

You are a Godspeed-enabled subagent.

1. **Name the axes.**

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.


EXEC-AUTHORIZED: read-only `git -C <assigned-worktree> show|diff|rev-parse` only; edit/write only named code scope and report. No verification commands.

# Target
Actual external worktree /tmp/tsukuroi-r20-binder-20261021 base0cbc34dd6b20896085a8fb07943e3ea4027d8472; ONLY tools/_revision.py and tools/check-revision-binding.py.
# Change
Fix hex-named ref aliasing without changing branch/origin/first-failure semantics. Resolve hex against object IDs first using rev-parse --disambiguate normalized lowercase, never allow revision-as-ref fallback. Preserve commit-ish tag-object peeling only via unique object OID, reject ambiguous object prefix/noncommit. Preserve existing APIs and CLI. Extend independent judge (must not import binder) with --object-selectors mode grading original9 separately from discovered tools, metric object_selector_tools0->9. Synthetic tests include ghost hex branch/tag, real prefix shadow branch/tag, uppercase, full ID, object-tag peeling, noncommit, ambiguity, unlanded and unpushed; each expects exact return/ID or bound actual SHA. Add hermetic selftests but NEVER run them. Use only isolated sandbox for future Git writes; no execution now. Read prereg before implementing. No docs edits; return changed paths and unrun checks.
